WindowGroup() { VolumetricWindow() } .windowStyle(.volumetric) // Scale the size of the window group relative to the volumetric window's size. .defaultSize( width: VolumetricWindow.defaultSize, height: heightModifier * VolumetricWindow.defaultSize, depth: VolumetricWindow.defaultSize, in: .meters ) } } ```
